query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('2ab871806b01d07fe7d93bf45ff4ce97bd156d168d7a08078ac8a517', '3a511ec25af655c1aef31d0d9c0c6154eae7321045b1fa46fac55ecd', '46b61f0584f21481b22ea18f945e48ac4148f50fc3ade494a7762440', '484e733d122af44e6101988bcc47ed261a7af5c43c797e89d60e3075', '8151b7a3d4c17bfd1d3779c2726e76a06db47e36ba6c160d9a2d60f6', '92e307862c5374ee78f3cfdaaa45447f7f0db6776d54fa5f8df1a85c', 'cb418959c00d6779e176fcf6227824a6ac3b5bea7a672ef66a216dae', 'd431d4cba00d664acb127bb391c211086ca72fe570fd85f139af578e', 'd91d08e381f8ef95ffbb3f8048f020d7361ded8f3abfdf66c25fa838', 'ed3fb7e046b4f3387e0749fb46847dbc15e85e61aaa76558f968136d')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
